title: Detailed anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Stock / shank -->
  <rect x="45" y="18" width="10" height="58" rx="4" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <rect x="47" y="18" width="2" height="58" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  
  <!-- Ring at top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFD54F" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFE082" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Stock (horizontal bar) -->
  <rect x="28" y="30" width="44" height="8" rx="4" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <rect x="28" y="30" width="44" height="3" rx="2" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  
  <!-- Left fluke/arm -->
  <path d="M50 76 Q50 90 30 92 Q10 94 12 80 Q14 68 24 70 Q30 71 32 78" 
        fill="none" stroke="#4FC3F7" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 76 Q50 90 30 92 Q10 94 12 80 Q14 68 24 70 Q30 71 32 78" 
        fill="none" stroke="#81D4FA" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Right fluke/arm -->
  <path d="M50 76 Q50 90 70 92 Q90 94 88 80 Q86 68 76 70 Q70 71 68 78" 
        fill="none" stroke="#4FC3F7" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>

        fill="none" stroke="#81D4FA" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Fluke tips (triangles) -->
  <path d="M10 82 L4 74 L8 88 Z" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <path d="M90 82 L96 74 L92 88 Z" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  
  <!-- Bottom tip / crown -->
  <path d="M43 72 L50 84 L57 72 Z" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <path d="M45 74 L50 82 L55 74 Z" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  
  <!-- Decorative rope wrap -->
  <path d="M38 45 Q50 50 62 45" fill="none" stroke="#FFD54F" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M38 52 Q50 57 62 52" fill="none" stroke="#FFD54F" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M38 59 Q50 64 62 59" fill="none" stroke="#FFD54F" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Rope accent dots -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="45" r="2.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="45" r="2.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="59" r="2.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="59" r="2.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  
  <!-- Stock end caps -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="34" r="5" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="34" r="5" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  
  <!-- Cute face / smile on shank -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="38" rx="1.8" ry="2.2" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <ellipse cx="53" cy="38" rx="1.8" ry="2.2" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <path d="M47 41 Q50 44 53 41" fill="none" stroke="#FFD54F" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
